description: This file contains functions related to displaying and managing case updates in SuiteCRM, including rendering update streams, handling AJAX updates, and displaying attachments.

methods.name: display_updates
methods.description: Generates HTML for the case updates stream, including toggle and AJAX functionality.

methods.name: display_update_form
methods.description: Renders the form for adding a new case update using Smarty template.

methods.name: getUpdateDisplayHead
methods.description: Creates the header HTML for a single update, including contact info and attachments.

methods.name: display_single_update
methods.description: Returns HTML for a single update, styled based on user or contact origin.

methods.name: display_case_attachments
methods.description: Returns HTML links for attachments linked to a case.

methods.name: quick_edit_case_updates
methods.description: Provides the inline form and JavaScript for AJAX updating of case updates in detail view.
